bootstrap.denominator_instability: If an eligible-residual denominator is zero in any bootstrap draw, that estimand is INCONCLUSIVE for the condition rather than repaired or reweighted.
bootstrap.resampling: paired canonical-base bootstrap within each arm and condition; retain all four views for each sampled base

invalidity_gates: every frozen raw evidence hash, target-sidecar hash, input-prompt hash, result hash, receipt hash, result-review brief hash, and Director-response binding must match
every raw arm must contain exactly 768 unique episode_id values equal to the target sidecar's set and its declared arm_id
every canonical base in each required condition must retain exactly turns 0,1,2,3
a parser-valid eligible view with non-rectangular grids, missing sole test input, tied target background mode, or an unclassifiable category is INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE
any category overlap or nonexhaustive eligible view is INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE

population.base_aggregation: For each category, compute count of eligible views in the four-view canonical base divided by four; report the unweighted mean over all 48 bases. Report eligible-view coverage separately. Do not drop bases with zero eligible views.
population.eligible_view: parser_valid is true AND parsed_grid differs from that episode's sealed target
population.unit: canonical base with four turn views retained

prospective_decision_rule.interpretation_limit: Descriptive morphology on reused synthetic development evidence only; no causal training mechanism, checkpoint promotion, intervention selection, or independent ARC generalization claim.
prospective_decision_rule.mechanism_dominant: For Treatment, one and only one category has lower 95 percent bootstrap bound above 0.50 of eligible parser-valid nonoracle views in both required conditions, and neither condition has denominator instability.
prospective_decision_rule.mixed_or_inconclusive: Otherwise, including disagreement across conditions, tied or absent dominance, invalid identities, nonexclusive taxonomy, or denominator instability.

required_reports: eligible, parser-invalid, and exact-target view counts by arm and condition
category counts and canonical-base equal-weight shares by arm and condition
Treatment versus Control and Treatment versus V7 per-base category-share deltas as descriptive evidence
all per-base four-view category vectors, with no adaptive filtering

task_schema_semantics.output_foreground_support: coordinates whose parsed output color differs from target_background, evaluated only when parsed output has target dimensions
task_schema_semantics.target_background: unique modal color in the sealed target grid; ties invalidate the affected view
task_schema_semantics.target_foreground_support: coordinates whose target color differs from target_background
task_schema_semantics.test_input: the sole grid at prompt.test[0].input, joined by episode_id
task_schema_semantics.translation_congruent: there is a single nonzero integer row/column offset that maps every target foreground coordinate bijectively to output foreground support within bounds; rotations, reflections, recoloring, cropping, and resizing do not qualify

taxonomy_precedence.DIMENSION_OR_CELL_COUNT_FAILURE: otherwise, output dimensions differ from target OR foreground-support cardinality differs from target; this is the residual catch-all and makes the taxonomy exhaustive
taxonomy_precedence.EXACT_INPUT_COPY: parsed_grid equals the full frozen test input grid exactly, before any target-shape comparison
taxonomy_precedence.TARGET_CELL_COUNT_PRESERVED_NONCONGRUENT: otherwise, dimensions match and output foreground-support cardinality equals target foreground-support cardinality
taxonomy_precedence.TARGET_CONGRUENT_GEOMETRY_WRONG_PLACEMEN: otherwise, dimensions match; output foreground support is a nonzero translation of target foreground support; and every output coordinate outside that support equals target_background
taxonomy_precedence.TARGET_FOREGROUND_GEOMETRY_COLOR_ONLY_ER: otherwise, target and output dimensions match; output foreground support equals target foreground support; every target-background coordinate equals target_background in the output; and at least one target-foreground color differs from target
